response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced and technically diverse senior software developer with strong open-source, Linux, and full-stack credentials, but he lacks several core requirements for this role: his German is listed as only 'Basic' against a required C1 minimum, Python and UML are absent from his skill set, and his work history shows no formal leadership, architecture-ownership, or client-advisory title (mostly 'Senior/Staff Developer' roles rather than tech lead or engineering management positions). These gaps make him a weak match despite his technical strength.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse software engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and backend systems
Deep open-source and Linux background, including founding and maintaining an OSS geo-data platform
Demonstrated communication and knowledge-sharing skills via conference talks and workshops
concerns: German proficiency listed as 'Basic', far below the required C1 minimum for client-facing advisory work
No mention of Python or UML, both explicitly desired technical skills for this role
No evidence of formal team leadership, project management, or IT security/compliance experience expected at this seniority level

key_factors.factor: German language level below C1 requirement
Lack of formal leadership/tech lead experience and UML/security background
Strong technical breadth and open-source/Linux expertise
